description:
Save a client in the company's registry, or update a saved one.

It records a recipient for later issuances; it issues nothing.
A document already saved is refused with the existing client's
id — call get_client or pass that id here to update it instead.
Confirm the data with the user when any of it was inferred.

Address.description: A plain postal address. State EX is a buyer abroad, NF-e only.

country_code.description: BACEN country code, 1 to 4 digits. Required, and not 1058, when state is EX. Its check digit is not verified: the official table has countries whose digit does not close.
country_code.title: Country Code

state_registration.description: Recipient's IE (inscrição estadual), NF-e only. Send it for a recipient registered as an ICMS contributor; ISENTO for an exempt one; leave it out for a non-contributor.
state_registration.title: State Registration

Address.title: Address

client_id.description: Update this saved client instead of creating one. Only the fields sent change.
client_id.title: Client Id

company_id.description: UUID of the company this call acts for, as list_authorized_companies shows it. Omit it when the connection covers a single company: that company is used. Required when the connection covers several — call list_authorized_companies to see them, with their ids and what each one allows. Give company_id or company_tax_id, never both.
company_id.title: Company Id

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company this call acts for — the company using Stackin, never the recipient or a taxpayer being looked up. Punctuation is ignored. Omit it when the connection covers a single company: that company is used. Required when the connection covers several — call list_authorized_companies to see them, with their ids and what each one allows. Give company_id or company_tax_id, never both.
company_tax_id.title: Company Tax Id

tax_id.description: CPF or CNPJ. Required, except for a buyer abroad (address.state EX).
tax_id.title: Tax Id

name: save_client

outputSchema.description: One client the company keeps between issuances.

id.description: Pass it as client_id to issue_invoice or save_client.
id.title: Id

source.description: manual, issued (imported from issued invoices) or issuance (saved by an issuance).
source.title: Source

outputSchema.title: ClientRecord
